claims.quote: The green panchax, Aplocheilus blockii, is a small killifish from Sri Lanka and southern India, growing to around 45 mm SL.
The green panchax, Aplocheilus blockii, is a small killifish from Sri Lanka and southern India, growing to around 45 mm SL.
Native to Sri Lanka and southern India with records in the latter existing from the states of Goa, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and more recently, Karnataka.
